# Apache ECharts runtime

This plugin expects the official Apache ECharts 6.1.0 browser distribution at:

`web/js/echarts.min.js`

Upstream source:
`https://github.com/apache/echarts/blob/6.1.0/dist/echarts.min.js`

Pinned Git blob SHA:
`3b8ed4bcd17f7c838d86d4920af588f1a0aeb389`

Run `scripts/vendor-echarts.sh` or `scripts/vendor-echarts.ps1` from the repository root.
The scripts verify the Git blob hash before accepting the asset.
